jen: Quick note: I'm updating the "Hello Quickstart" to use the new SDK v10 auth helpers and a tiny local auth-proxy for private deployments. Want a quick sanity-check on wording + CI smoke flow.

oscar: Nice. Will this be additive? i.e., keep current API key examples?

jen: Yes — plan: default page shows SDK v10 OIDC flow, then an "If you use API_KEY" collapsible section with the legacy snippet. I'll also add a short migration checklist for teams using Dedicated.

lina: Can you paste the new SDK snippet here so I can check copy & paste accuracy?

jen: Sure — short example (pseudo):

```
# .env (recommended for private deployments)
REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE=oidc
OIDC_PROVIDER=https://accounts.example.com
OIDC_CLIENT_ID=rr-quickstart-client
REDWOOD_ENV=local

# Python quickstart
from redwood import Client
client = Client(auth_mode="oidc")
resp = client.generate("Hello from Quickstart")
print(resp.text)
```

jen: Also adding docker-compose override with a tiny proxy service that performs local OIDC code exchange to avoid needing a real IdP during dev.

oscar: For CI, let's add a smoke job that brings up compose + runs `tests/quickstart_smoke.py`. We should use the prow secret helper to inject test client secrets. Lina, can you add the smoke test harness?

lina: Yep. I'll add `tests/quickstart_smoke.py` and a wrapper `scripts/ci/run_quickstart_smoke.sh`. Will use `---ci` label so docs pipeline picks it up.

jen: I'll update the docs PR with instructions for local developers to run the smoke test: `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml up --build` then `./scripts/dev/seed_oidc_test_secrets.sh`.

oscar: Minor wording nit: don't call the proxy a "mini IdP" in the docs. Call it "local auth proxy (dev-only)" and make the security warnings prominent.

jen: Good point. Also adding note about storing OIDC client secrets in KMS/HSM for Private customers and linking to the security guide.

lina: One more ask: can we include a small migration checklist for Dedicated customers? Something like: 1) create OIDC client in your IdP, 2) rotate keys, 3) update REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE, 4) run smoke tests, 5) monitor token rotation.

jen: Yep will add that under "Migrating from API_KEY to OIDC". I'll keep the legacy API_KEY appendix live for 7 days before we prompt users to migrate docs links.

docs-bot: PR opened by jen: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4890 - quickstart: SDKv10 auth + local proxy + CI smoke job

oscar: I'll review the PR today and push a small CI tweak to use the prow helper. If tests look green we'll merge after docs + eng signoff.

lina: I'll push the smoke test later today. @jen please add a one-liner to run the smoke test locally in the PR description.

jen: Added. Targeting merge tomorrow 11:00 PT. Thanks! :rocket:
